HelloGitHub Vol.125

Published on August 28, 2026

HelloGitHub shares interesting, beginner-friendly open-source projects from GitHub, updated every month on the 28th. Discover fun beginner projects, open-source books, practical tutorials, and enterprise-grade projects, helping you quickly experience and become interested in the charm of open source.

C
1、
RetroArch
Star 1.4w
Fork 2.2k
3 minutes ago

One-stop Retro Game Emulator.This project is an official cross-platform emulator developed by Libretro, which can dynamically load various console emulators and game engines. It provides multiple functions like shaders, instant saving, controller operation, and video recording, and supports platforms such as Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, as well as PS, Xbox, and Nintendo consoles.

C#
2、
DeskBox
Star 1.4k
Fork 105
3 minutes ago

Keep Windows Desktop Organized.This is an open-source Windows desktop organization tool that adds file grids with a native Windows aesthetic and daily tools to the desktop. It includes built-in widgets such as to-do lists, note-taking, search, weather, and music control. It supports features like mapping existing folders, automatically organizing desktop files, and QuickLook previews.

3、
DiscordChatExporter
Star 1.2w
Fork 1k
3 minutes ago

Discord Chat History Export Tool.This is a C#-based Discord message export tool that can export direct messages, group chats, and channel messages into files, supporting output formats like HTML, TXT, CSV, and JSON, while preserving content such as Markdown, attachments, and emojis, with exported results viewable offline

4、
tubatools
Star 2.5k
Fork 73
3 minutes ago

Windows PC Hardware Detection Tool.This project is a Windows system toolbox developed with C# and WinUI 3, integrating functions such as hardware detection, system installation assistant, network diagnosis, and junk cleaning.

C++
5、
EUI-NEO
Star 1.7k
Fork 159
3 minutes ago

Lightweight Cross-Platform UI Framework for C++.This is a lightweight declarative UI framework for C++ applications, which doesn't require introducing WebView or script runtime. It supports GLFW/SDL2 window backends and OpenGL/Vulkan rendering backends, and features built-in layout, animation, event, asynchronous, network request, and image loading, along with optional modules like keyboard and serial port.

6、
fooyin
Star 2.3k
Fork 94
3 minutes ago

Music Player with Customizable Interface.This is a desktop music player with a fully customizable interface, allowing users to freely arrange the interface from a blank canvas or preset layouts. It supports mainstream audio formats like FLAC, MP3, Opus, and offers functions such as seamless playback, tag editing, audio conversion, synchronized lyrics display, and internet radio. It can also extend features via plugins and the built-in FooScript scripting.

Go
7、
casos
Star 1.2k
Fork 89
3 minutes ago

Out-of-the-Box Cloud Operating System.This project is a cloud operating system built on Kubernetes, integrating the API Server, Controller Manager, and Scheduler into a single executable file. You can have a cloud operating system with a web management interface and app store without setting up a cluster or writing YAML.

8、
dbmate
Star 7.2k
Fork 366
3 minutes ago

Lightweight Database Migration Tool.This is a Go-based database migration tool that keeps database schemas in sync across multiple developers and production servers. It is ready-to-use out of the box, uses pure SQL for migration scripts, is language and framework agnostic, and supports databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and ClickHouse.

9、
devpod
Star 1.5w
Fork 578
3 minutes ago

Open-Source Cloud Development Environment.This project is a client-side development environment tool based on the DevContainer standard, which can create consistent containerized development environments on local machines, K8s, remote machines, or cloud servers. It supports access via SSH, VSCode, and JetBrains, and provides functions such as pre-building, automatic idle shutdown, and credential synchronization

10、
hister
Star 3.1k
Fork 139
3 minutes ago

Personal Browsing History Search Engine.This project is a personal search engine developed in Go, which can perform full-text search on the web pages and local files you have browsed, and supports features such as automatic inclusion of newly accessed pages by Firefox/Chrome extensions, import of browser history, field filtering, wildcard and semantic search

Java
11、
droidVNC-NG
Star 2.1k
Fork 297
3 minutes ago

Android Remote Desktop Tool.This is a tool designed for local area networks to remotely view and control Android devices. You can operate the phone by opening a browser, and it doesn't require root access. It supports functions such as mouse and keyboard operation, clipboard sharing, file transfer, and screen scaling

12、
grimmory
Star 4.1k
Fork 302
3 minutes ago

Self-hosted E-book, Comic, and Audiobook Library.This is an open-source digital library that supports managing e-books, comics, and audiobooks. It enables reading, annotating, and tracking progress in the browser, and provides features such as smart bookshelves, full-text search, metadata scraping, and one-click sending to Kindle.

JavaScript
13、
flint-chart
Star 4k
Fork 219
3 minutes ago

A Visual Language Designed for AI.This is a visual intermediate language for AI agents. It can generate beautiful and accurate charts through concise, human-editable code. It automatically handles parameters such as layout, axes, and labels, derives more appropriate chart configurations, and provides MCP services for agents to call directly.

14、
gpu.js
Star 1.5w
Fork 661
3 minutes ago

Running JavaScript Code on the GPU.This is a general-purpose GPU computing acceleration library for JavaScript. It can convert simple JavaScript functions into Shader Code suitable for different backends, enabling parallel execution on the GPU and significantly improving computing speed

15、
LinearAbiltyCastingThreeJS
Star 735
Fork 154
3 minutes ago

Cool Skill Effects Sandbox.This is a skill effects sandbox implemented with Three.js and GLSL, featuring 5 skills: frost, lightning, meteor, beam, and trap. All effects are generated procedurally, and it supports functions like arrow aiming, click-to-release, and pause adjustment.

16、
prehistoric-animal-museum
Star 653
Fork 94
3 minutes ago

Accompanying Kids to Virtually Explore the Prehistoric Animal Museum Online.This project is a 3D prehistoric animal museum designed specifically for children, featuring 18 kinds of animals from the sea, land, and air, and supporting functions such as rotation, zooming, bilingual (Chinese and English) narration, and setting exploration avatars.

Kotlin
17、
ZenConverter
Star 762
Fork 19
3 minutes ago

Open-Source Android File Format Converter.This is an ad-free, free Android file format conversion tool. All conversions are carried out locally on the mobile phone, with no need to upload files to servers. It supports audio/video, image, PDF, font, subtitle and other types of files.

Python
18、
airllm
Star 3.3w
Fork 3.5k
3 minutes ago

Running 70B Large Models with Just 4GB VRAM.This is a Python library that drastically reduces inference VRAM usage via hierarchical loading. It can run 70B large models with only 4GB VRAM without quantization, distillation, or pruning. It supports mainstream models such as Llama 3.x, Qwen3, DeepSeek, and offers prefetch acceleration, 8bit/4bit quantization, and macOS support.

19、
PYAS
Star 452
Fork 40
3 minutes ago

Antivirus Software Written in Python.This is a Windows antivirus software developed with Python and C++ that intercepts threats through machine learning and behavior monitoring, supporting PE file scanning, cloud detection, signature verification, and system protection functions such as files, processes, and registries

20、
ServerKit
Star 883
Fork 96
3 minutes ago

Lightweight Server Control Panel.This is a server management panel built with Flask and React. It only occupies 180MB of memory during runtime and can uniformly manage services such as websites, databases, and Docker. It comes with over 100 one - click installation application templates and supports functions like multi - machine monitoring, automatic renewal of HTTPS certificates, scheduled backups, and a file manager.

21、
watermarks-remover
Star 1.9w
Fork 2.2k
3 minutes ago

Tool to Remove AI Watermarks.This is a tool designed to remove source marks and invisible watermarks from AI-generated content, which can handle watermarks from Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, etc., and supports various content types such as text, images, documents, and videos.

Rust
22、
floral-notepaper
Star 4.9k
Fork 278
3 minutes ago

Lightweight and Elegant Cross-Platform Desktop Sticky Note Tool.This project is a desktop sticky note tool built with Tauri 2 and React. It allows you to call up the sticky note window at any time by pressing global hotkeys. It supports features like Markdown editing with real-time preview, multiple small windows, and tile mode, and is compatible with Windows and macOS systems.

23、
tuicr
Star 2.9k
Fork 237
3 minutes ago

A Tool for Convenient Code Review in Terminal.This is a terminal-based code review tool that supports Vim keybindings, allowing continuous browsing of all changes and adding comments in the command line. Comments can be submitted as formal reviews to GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket with a single click, and it can also be exported to Markdown, being compatible with git, jj, and Mercurial

24、
WindInput
Star 265
Fork 21
3 minutes ago

Open-Source Chinese Input Method Written in Rust.This is a lightweight Chinese input method written in Rust, which has low resource consumption, fast startup speed, and supports Wubi 86, mixed Wubi-Pinyin input, full pinyin, and double pinyin.

Skills
25、
dashi-ppt-skill
Star 6.4k
Fork 618
3 minutes ago

Let AI Agents Help You Create PPTs.This is a skill package that can generate editable PPTs. You can throw documents to the agent to create web-based PPTs, which support directly modifying text, changing images, adjusting layouts in the browser, and one-click exporting to editable PPT files.

26、
effective-html
Star 2.5k
Fork 184
3 minutes ago

AI-Powered HTML Prototyping and Chart Generation.This project enables AI agents to generate HTML visualizations that can be opened directly in browsers, including reports, interactive prototypes, strategic roadmaps, architectures, and flowcharts, etc.

27、
i-have-adhd
Star 2.5w
Fork 1.6k
3 minutes ago

Skills to Make AI Get to the Point Directly.This project formulates 10 output rules based on the method in the book The Adult ADHD Tool Kit, including prioritizing actions, numbering steps, keeping lists to no more than 5 items, etc., and omits opening remarks, reviews, and polite closings to make AI output key points directly

28、
ian-xiaohei-illustrations
Star 1w
Fork 1.3k
3 minutes ago

Skill to Generate Hand-drawn Illustrations for Articles.This project is an Agent skill for generating hand-drawn illustrations for Chinese articles. It can extract judgments, processes, states, and metaphors from the article, and create 16:9 body illustrations that are white-background, hand-drawn, interesting, and crisp

Swift
29、
Crisp
Star 1.3k
Fork 53
3 minutes ago

Free macOS External Display Management Tool.This is a macOS menu bar application for controlling external displays, completely free of charge. It supports functions such as brightness/volume/arrangement adjustment, HiDPI scaling, preset configuration, virtual displays, etc.

30、
MacPacker
Star 614
Fork 29
3 minutes ago

Free macOS Compression Package Manager.This is a free and open-source macOS compression package management tool. It enables you to view contents as if browsing a folder without extraction, and you can directly drag out the required files. It supports over 40 compression package and disk image formats.

AI
31、
book-to-skill
Star 2.6w
Fork 2.7k
3 minutes ago

Turning Technical Books into Agent Skills.This is a tool that converts technical books and documents into Agent skills, enabling AI coding assistants to load them on demand and answer based on the original book content. It automatically generates SKILL.md, chapter - split files, glossaries, and cheat sheets, reducing token consumption by 20 - 50 times compared to directly including the whole book in the context, and supports formats such as PDF, EPUB, DOCX, and Markdown.

32、
deepseek-harness
Star 20w
Fork 2.3w
3 minutes ago

DeepSeek Open-Source Agent Framework.This project is an open-source agent framework officially released by DeepSeek. It adopts a plug-in-everything design philosophy, where model adapters, tools, conversation logs, and agent loops are all replaceable plugins, and it offers an out-of-the-box web interface.

33、
oh-my-pi
Star 2.8w
Fork 2.8k
3 minutes ago

Bringing IDE Capabilities to Terminal Programming Agents.This is a terminal AI coding agent developed with TypeScript and Rust, evolved from the open-source project Pi, focusing on bringing IDE capabilities to the agent. It deeply integrates LSP into every code modification, where renaming will synchronously update all references, and it can also call debuggers like lldb, dlv, debugpy to locate issues, and is compatible with macOS, Linux, and Windows systems.

34、
pipecat
Star 1.5w
Fork 2.6k
3 minutes ago

The Framework of Real-time Speech AI Agents.This is a Python framework designed for building real-time speech and multimodal dialogue agents. It can orchestrate speech recognition, large models, and speech synthesis into composable processing pipelines. It enables ultra-low latency interaction through WebSocket or WebRTC. Each pipeline functions as an Agent, supporting multi-agent collaboration modes like task handover, parallel distribution, and cross-process distributed deployment, and is applicable to scenarios such as voice assistants, online customer service, and companion applications.

35、
plannotator
Star 8.1k
Fork 600
3 minutes ago

Tool for Annotating AI Coding Agent Output.This is a locally run AI coding agent review tool. When the AI outputs a plan or finishes writing code, it automatically opens a review interface in the browser, supports annotating plans, commenting on diffs and PRs, and feedback is directly sent back to the agent for execution, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, etc.

Other
36、
bee-write-back
Star 452
Fork 23
3 minutes ago

Building a Digital Typewriter with Raspberry Pi.This project is a dedicated writing device made with a Raspberry Pi, a 5.5-inch screen, and a mechanical keyboard. The author originally created it to solve the problem of helping with sleep aid when writing diaries before bed and avoiding being affected by old diaries, with a cost of about $200.

37、
IHaskell
Star 2.6k
Fork 266
3 minutes ago

Running Haskell Code in Jupyter.This project allows you to interactively write and run Haskell code in Jupyter Notebook, supporting all versions of GHC from 8.4 to 9.14. It provides multiple installation methods such as Hackage, source code compilation, Docker, Nix, etc., and can also be experienced through a browser

38、
Lithe-IDEA
Star 420
Fork 56
3 minutes ago

Lightweight Java IDE Programming Tool.This is a lightweight IDE aimed at Java and Spring Boot developers, with a runtime memory usage of only 300-400 MB, supporting functions such as global search, code jumping, Maven, breakpoint debugging, database management, etc., and applicable to macOS and Windows systems

39、
mhabit
Star 1.5k
Fork 86
3 minutes ago

Cross-Platform Habit-Tracking App.This is an app for cultivating and tracking personal habits. It helps users develop habits more efficiently through daily check-ins. It not only counts consecutive check-in days but also provides a growth curve to quantify long-term persistence. It supports WebDAV multi-platform synchronization, custom colors, and habit grouping, and is applicable to Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms.

40、
newtab-naivetab
Star 98
Fork 10
3 minutes ago

Visual Keyboard New Tab.This project is a browser extension that displays bookmarks using a keyboard layout. It can bind bookmarks and commands to keys, allowing direct access to websites by pressing the corresponding keys in the new tab. It has built-in practical widgets, supports drag-and-drop layout, focus mode, and cloud synchronization, and is compatible with Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.

HelloGitHub Vol.124

Published on July 28, 2026

HelloGitHub shares interesting, beginner-friendly open-source projects from GitHub, updated every month on the 28th. Discover fun beginner projects, open-source books, practical tutorials, and enterprise-grade projects, helping you quickly experience and become interested in the charm of open source.

C
1、
86Box
Star 4.4k
Fork 539
5 minutes ago

Retro PC Emulator.This is an open-source retro computer emulator that allows free combination and emulation of various classic hardware, such as Pentium and Celeron processors, sound cards, graphics cards, etc. It supports running early operating systems like DOS, Windows 98, Windows XP, and software from the same era.

2、
simplewall
Star 8.7k
Fork 636
5 minutes ago

Compact Windows Network Control Tool.This is a tool for managing and controlling Windows network activities. It is compact, ad-free, and completely free. It implements network filtering based on WFP, doesn't rely on the system's built-in firewall, and supports features like custom rules, IPv6, and block lists.

C#
3、
FluentCleaner
Star 4.1k
Fork 127
5 minutes ago

Better Windows System Cleaner.This is a Windows system cleanup tool built on WinUI 3, inspired by the classic CCleaner. It utilizes a winapp2.ini rule base that has been maintained for many years and covers thousands of applications, supports custom rule bases and silent automatic cleanup, with a transparent, precise, and hassle-free cleanup process

4、
nvidiaProfileInspector
Star 6.9k
Fork 375
5 minutes ago

Unlocking Hidden NVIDIA Driver Settings.This is a Windows tool for editing NVIDIA driver configuration files, which can access hidden options not shown in the official control panel. It supports creating separate profiles for individual games, adjusting parameters like frame rate limits, vertical sync, texture filtering, and ray tracing, and configurations can be exported as .nip files for easy backup or sharing.

C++
5、
JoltPhysics
Star 1.1w
Fork 853
5 minutes ago

Physics Engine Behind Death Stranding 2.This is a rigid body physics and collision detection library written in C++ that supports multi-core concurrency and deterministic simulation. It provides continuous collision detection for shapes like spheres, cubes, capsules, and functions like various constraint types, soft body, and hair simulation. This library is used in games such as Horizon Forbidden West and Death Stranding 2

Go
6、
App-Store-Connect-CLI
Star 5.2k
Fork 455
5 minutes ago

Command-Line App Store Application Publishing.This is a Go-written command-line tool for App Store Connect, which can automate app publishing in terminals, IDEs, or CI/CD pipelines, supporting operations like build upload, TestFlight, submission for review, and signing, covering all platforms including iOS, macOS, tvOS, and visionOS

7、
kage
Star 2.8k
Fork 107
5 minutes ago

Packing Entire Websites for Offline Reading.This project is a website offline saving tool developed in Go, which can save any website as a local folder for offline browsing. The saved web pages look the same as online but won't initiate any network requests. It also supports packaging into a single .zim file or a directly executable file.

8、
make-look-scanned
Star 569
Fork 28
5 minutes ago

Making PDFs Look Like Scans.This project can process PDF files to make them look like scanned documents, supports running via command line and locally in the browser, and the same file will get exactly the same result by default.

9、
zabbix
Star 6.1k
Fork 1.2k
5 minutes ago

Open-Source Enterprise-Grade Distributed Monitoring Platform.This project is an enterprise-grade open-source distributed monitoring system that can monitor the running status of network devices, servers, databases, virtual machines, containers, cloud services, and applications in real time. It supports features such as automatic discovery, Agent/Agent-less collection, and fault detection, and can send alerts via Slack, Jira, Teams, email, or SMS. Zabbix also has a very active community in China.

Java
10、
jabref
Star 4.4k
Fork 3.5k
5 minutes ago

Literature Management Tools for Academic Papers.This is a free, open-source, cross-platform literature and citation management tool that natively supports BibTeX/BibLaTeX. It can retrieve papers from platforms like Google Scholar and arXiv, auto-complete bibliographic information, extract PDF metadata, merge duplicate entries, and integrate with Word, LibreOffice, and multiple LaTeX editors.

JavaScript
11、
astryx
Star 1.1w
Fork 858
5 minutes ago

Meta Open-Source React Design System.This project is a design system built on React and StyleX, having been practiced internally by Meta for many years. It features over 150 components, 7 customizable themes, dark mode, page templates, and a CLI, and is AI Agent-friendly.

12、
ColorTxt
Star 605
Fork 36
5 minutes ago

A Novel Reader That Colors Text.This local novel reader built on Electron supports formats such as TXT, EPUB, MOBI, PDF. It can automatically color proper nouns and key terms in the text, and supports functions like chapter recognition, highlighting notes, text-to-speech, and AI plot analysis

13、
karakeep
Star 2.8w
Fork 1.4k
5 minutes ago

Self-Hosted Browser Bookmark Management Platform.This is a self-hosted browser bookmark management application that can save links, notes, images, and PDFs, and supports AI-powered automatic tagging and summary generation. It offers features such as full-text search, OCR, browser extensions, mobile applications, RSS auto-collection, and web archiving.

14、
magic-resume
Star 8.9k
Fork 1k
5 minutes ago

Online AI Resume Editor.This is a free online AI resume editor that requires no login and comes with multiple built-in templates. It is built on TanStack Start, TypeScript, and Tiptap, and supports features such as real-time preview, AI service provider configuration, dark mode, PDF export, and auto-save.

15、
TREK
Star 1.1w
Fork 908
5 minutes ago

Multi-Person Collaborative Travel Planning Platform.This is a self-hosted travel planning platform that supports features such as real-time multi-person collaboration, interactive maps, expense sharing, packing lists, booking management, and travel itineraries. It has an integrated MCP service and can work with an AI assistant to plan trips.

Python
16、
abogen
Star 5.4k
Fork 397
5 minutes ago

Audiobook Generator with Synchronized Subtitles.This is a text-to-speech audiobook generator based on Kokoro-82M, which can convert EPUB, PDF, TXT, Markdown, and subtitle files into audio formats like MP3, M4B, and FLAC. It provides functions such as batch processing, chapter splitting, and speed adjustment, and supports 9 languages including Chinese.

17、
git-filter-repo
Star 1.3w
Fork 987
5 minutes ago

Git History Rewriting Tool.This is a command-line tool for rewriting Git repository history, serving as an alternative to git filter-branch. It only requires Python and Git to run, and supports functions such as batch rewriting commit messages, tag renaming, repository splitting, and automatic cleanup.

18、
HypoMux
Star 1.9k
Fork 64
5 minutes ago

Banding Together Bandwidth from Multiple Network Cards.This is a download acceleration tool for bandwidth aggregation from multiple network cards, specifically developed for the Windows platform. When the computer is connected to both wired Ethernet, Wi-Fi, or a mobile hotspot simultaneously, it can distribute download tasks to different network cards, achieving download speeds far exceeding that of a single network card, and supports features such as virtual network cards, process sharding, and real-time traffic monitoring.

19、
msgspec
Star 3.9k
Fork 163
5 minutes ago

Faster Python Serialization Library.This is a high-performance Python serialization and data validation library that supports JSON, MessagePack, YAML, and TOML formats, with common operations being 10-80 times faster than similar libraries

20、
wenyi
Star 1.7k
Fork 139
5 minutes ago

Tool for Translating Entire Foreign Novels.This is a command-line tool for translating long novels, supporting file formats like EPUB, FB2, TXT, Markdown, HTML, and PDF. It improves the consistency and readability of long novel translations through full-book analysis, rolling context, dynamic glossaries, polishing, and proofreading.

Rust
21、
harper
Star 1.4w
Fork 522
5 minutes ago

Locally-Prioritized English Grammar Checker.This is an English grammar checking tool developed in Rust. It can perform grammar analysis locally without uploading content to the server. With fast checking speed and low memory usage, it can be compiled into WebAssembly for running in browsers and integrated into editors such as VS Code, Neovim, Helix, Emacs, and Zed.

22、
herdr
Star 2.1w
Fork 1.4k
5 minutes ago

Terminal Tool for Managing Multiple AI Coding Assistants.This project is a Rust-written terminal multiplexer specifically designed for operating multiple AI coding assistants simultaneously. It enables you to view the terminal screen of each assistant within one screen, easily seeing who is running, who is stuck, and who has completed. It supports resuming after disconnection and allows reconnection from other terminals or SSH at any time, and is also compatible with tmux-style shortcuts.

Skills
23、
archify
Star 7.5k
Fork 555
5 minutes ago

AI-powered Code-to-Architecture Diagram Generation.This is an architecture diagram generation skill designed for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenCode. It can read code repositories or system descriptions to generate interactive architecture diagrams. It provides 5 types of diagrams and 4 sets of themes, supports node searching, upstream and downstream link tracing, architecture change comparison, and can be exported to PNG or SVG.

24、
claude-video
Star 1.1w
Fork 1.1k
5 minutes ago

Enabling AI Assistants to Understand Videos.This is a skill pack that equips AI assistants like Claude Code with the ability to understand videos. After inputting a video URL or local file, it uses yt-dlp and FFmpeg to extract key frames and subtitles. When there are no subtitles, it can utilize Whisper for transcription, allowing AI assistants to locate screen recording issues, analyze content, or generate summaries by combining visuals and audio

25、
hallmark
Star 1.9w
Fork 942
5 minutes ago

Rejecting AI-like Web Design Skills.This is a web design skill oriented towards Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, aiming to avoid the homogeneity of AI-generated pages. It features 20 themes, 4 command modes, 57 check rules, a self-check process, and supports extracting design features from screenshots or URLs.

Swift
26、
LockIME
Star 485
Fork 17
5 minutes ago

macOS Menu Bar Tool for Locking Input Method.This is a macOS menu bar tool developed with SwiftUI, which can lock the specified input method globally or for specific applications/URLs. It will revert immediately if manually switched or changed by other applications. It supports features like custom shortcuts, rule backup, configuration import and export, with an installation package size under 3MB and no need for system permissions

27、
opendisplay
Star 1.9k
Fork 124
5 minutes ago

Turn Your iPhone into a Mac Extended Screen.This is a free and open-source macOS secondary screen tool that can turn an idle iPhone or iPad into a second display. It can be used by connecting with a data cable or the same Wi-Fi. You can directly drag windows over and support tapping, dragging with fingers, and two-finger scrolling to operate the Mac.

28、
WhichSpace
Star 747
Fork 40
5 minutes ago

Desktop Space Switcher in Menu Bar.This is a tool for viewing and switching macOS desktops, which supports quickly switching desktops by clicking icons or scrolling the mouse, and can set colors, icons, text labels, or emojis for each desktop

AI
29、
code-review-graph
Star 2.7w
Fork 2.5k
5 minutes ago

Graph Tool to Help AI Read Less Code.This is a local-first code intelligence graph tool designed specifically for MCP and CLI. It parses relationships between functions, classes, calls, and tests using Tree-sitter, and persists them as a graph. When a file is modified, it can trace through the graph to find affected callers and dependent code, providing more precise context and avoiding token waste from reading the entire codebase.

30、
gastown
Star 1.7w
Fork 1.6k
5 minutes ago

Simultaneously Orchestrating Multiple AI Coding Assistants.This project is a multi-agent workspace management and orchestration system that can uniformly schedule AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Codex to work in parallel. It persists the work state using Git, so the context is not lost after agent restart, allowing continuous work to continue. It also provides functions like real-time monitoring, task handover, stuck detection, and queue merging, and supports the collaboration of 20-30 agents.

31、
harbor
Star 3.6k
Fork 1.4k
5 minutes ago

AI Agent Evaluation Framework.This is an open-source framework for evaluating AI agents and large models. You can use a single command to spin up agents like Claude Code and Codex CLI in Docker and run benchmarks with evaluation sets such as SWE-Bench. If local speed is slow, you can connect to cloud platforms like Daytona to run multiple environments simultaneously.

32、
OpenMontage
Star 4.3w
Fork 5.1k
5 minutes ago

Turning AI Coding Assistants into Video Studios.This is an open-source agent-based video production system that enables Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, and Codex to complete research, scriptwriting, material generation, editing, and synthesis based on natural language. It incorporates 12 production processes, over 100 tools, and more than 700 skill and production knowledge files, supporting real materials, AI images, voiceovers, subtitles, and finished product self-inspection.

33、
outlines
Star 1.5w
Fork 823
5 minutes ago

Strict LLM Structured Output Framework.This is a Python library that constrains the output format of large language models, ensuring results conform to the specified structure during generation, rather than patching with regular expressions after generation. When called, you only need to pass in the expected type, and the same code can seamlessly switch among OpenAI, Ollama, and vLLM

Other
34、
crosspoint-reader
Star 6.5k
Fork 1.3k
5 minutes ago

Open-source Firmware for Xteink E-ink Readers.This is an open-source e-reader firmware that can replace the original system of Xteink X3, X4, and other ESP32-C3 devices. It can be flashed via USB by connecting to a browser. It supports formats like EPUB, TXT, etc., allows customizing fonts, themes, and buttons, and provides features such as dictionary lookup, KOReader progress synchronization, and wireless file transfer via a web interface.

35、
exercises-dataset
Star 1.7w

    // Create a bunny Sprite

    // Center the sprite's anchor point

    // Move the sprite to the center of the screen

    bunny.y = app.screen.height / 2;
